key_points: Institutional investors (Soltis, China Universal, Brooklands) have recently initiated or increased positions in LRCX.
Stock price jumped 3‑5% in the past few days, reflecting strong buying momentum.
Record foundry sales and expectations of a memory‑shortage cycle are driving a sector‑wide rally that benefits LRCX.
Supply‑constraint concerns noted by Seeking Alpha are viewed as manageable given current demand.
Analysts rank LRCX among top buy candidates, supporting a bullish outlook.
